newsitem.title: UK: UK to spend near 500 mln stg/yr on big road upkeep.
newsitem.headline: UK to spend near 500 mln stg/yr on big road upkeep.

text.p: Transport Secretary Sir George Young on Tuesday defended Britain's record on the upkeep of major roads against criticism by MPs, and said almost 1.5 billion stg would be spent in the next three years.

Young was speaking a week after the publication of a report by parliament's Transport Committee which said planned spending on trunk road maintenance at 250 million stg this year was below the level needed to maintain the condition of the road network.

"Contrary to some suggestions, our trunk road network is in good condition thanks to almost three billion stg of sensible and well-timed expenditure on capital maintenance over the last 10 years," Young said.
"And we will shortly be publishing plans for almost 1.5 billion stg of expenditure over the next three years," he told a conference organised by Britain's Royal Automobile Club.

Last week's committee report warned: "The overwhelming message from the evidence we have received is that spending on national and local road and bridge maintenance has been insufficient to maintain these important national assets in good condition." -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
